name: Capital Punishment
overview: Scripture establishes the sanctity of human life as created in God's image, mandating capital punishment for those who unlawfully take a life, as seen in Genesis 9:6 and Exodus 21:12. The law requires that a murderer be put to death based on the testimony of multiple witnesses, ensuring justice is carried out with due process (Numbers 35:30). While Exodus 20:13 commands not to kill, the context of capital punishment distinguishes lawful execution from murder, affirming God's justice in holding man accountable for shedding blood (Genesis 9:5-6; Leviticus 24:17).
